environment.description: Same EKS cluster (v1.28) with user-service pod in namespace 'backend'. Istio sidecar with STRICT mTLS PeerAuthentication. Database access uses AWS RDS IAM authentication with pod-level IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) where the IAM role's session credentials are vended by the EKS Pod Identity webhook with a MaxSessionDuration of 60 seconds. The RDS IAM auth token generated from these session credentials inherits the 60s session window. Additionally, a Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (v1beta1) enforces that all pods in the 'backend' namespace must have the annotation 'security.company.io/query-sanitization: enabled' which triggers an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate that injects a sidecar running pgbouncer-rr (query rewriting proxy) configured with a SQL allowlist pattern: only parameterized queries matching '^SELECT .+ FROM users WHERE id = \$1$' are forwarded to RDS. The pgbouncer-rr sidecar binds to 127.0.0.1:5432 and the NetworkPolicy blocks all egress from the user-service pod to the RDS endpoint on port 5432 directly - only the sidecar's egress is permitted via a Cilium L7 policy with DNS-aware filtering for the RDS hostname.

config.cilium_l7_policy: DNS-aware egress to *.rds.amazonaws.com:5432 only from pgbouncer-rr container
